qc.label_under_test: The word 'you' meaning anyone, as the subject of a tip's main clause right after a reason or condition (', so you can…', 'If…, you'll want…'); quiet for 'you' as an object or in a story about a past event, and for other subjects (we, she, one) in the same tip

neighbours.label: Small function words in expository or how-to prose that sit right before a clause's verb or a plural noun phrase: expletive 'there' (there are, there needs to be), 'of' after a quantifier (many of, some of, one of), and 'you' before a modal (so you can); quiet for locative 'there', possessive 'of' (roof of the house) and 'you' as an object
